description: Create or replace a file under wp-content/themes, wp-content/plugins or wp-content/uploads, e.g. path "themes/bakery/style.css". Folders are made as needed. Use content for text or content_base64 for binary (25 MB at most).

path.description: relative to wp-content, starting with themes/, plugins/ or uploads/

site.description: the site name, from create_site or list_sites

token.description: the token create_site returned (oxa_...); leave out when Oxyforge is connected with an account agent key

name: write_file
title: Write a file
